description: In this workshop, discover how generative AI, Zero-ETL integrations from Amazon Aurora to Amazon Redshift, a lakehouse architecture on Amazon S3, and a conversational analytics layer powered by Amazon Quick combine to break down data silos — enabling any authorized user to ask complex financial questions in plain English and receive instant, accurate, visual answers, transforming time-to-insight from days to seconds.
title: Accelerating Financial Analytics: Lakehouse, Amazon SageMaker Unified Studio & Amazon Quick
